labels_provenance.author: v0.10 single annotator (implementer)
notes: Author labels are preserved; the independent adjudicator reproduced them or flagged a documented disagreement.
The adjudicator is a deterministic proxy, not a second human annotator. AT-07 remains partial.
Image-family adjudication: all three committed image cases are expressible at the annotated company-logo path; label_status=verified, no case excluded as a gap.

dataset.split_policy: The split was fixed before the first live run. Calibration cases may be used to tune prompts or routing; holdout cases must not be used for tuning and are reported separately.

governance.note: AT-07 remains partial: the deterministic adjudicator is a proxy, not human double review.

image_family.note: Image-family adjudication: each committed image case asks for the company logo and the schema exposes that exact image path; the v0.10 0% semantic pass was caused by forbidden-scope contamination, not an inexpressible label. No case is a gap. The image scorecard is reported separately so the aggregate cannot hide it.

notes: These are observations from a fixed, synthetic case set, not statistical significance. Repeats are not independent samples of a population; they show run-to-run variation for the same prompt. No single winner is declared: each metric has its own leader, and ties are shown.
Labels were authored by the implementer and adjudicated by benchmarks/adjudicate_labels.py, a deterministic independent proxy. No second human annotator exists, so AT-07 remains partial.

valid_template_rate is the deterministic validation + compilation rate over completed logical runs; technical failures are counted separately in technical_failure_rate and are not semantic failures. The rate is never folded into precision, recall or F1.
Gemini 3.6-flash is unpriced; its cost is estimated with the named proxy and is never reported as $0.00.
Ground truth is authored for synthetic fixtures and reflects this project's judgement.
Image-family labels are reported separately; no image case is excluded as a label gap.
Verified Docentric AX compatibility is not tested by this harness.
Per-run records live in the git-ignored gold_runs.jsonl; no prompt text or raw provider output is committed.
